text:
I do not recommend Prestige Clinic in Chiang Mai. I was extremely disappointed with the facial treatment. The price (2500B) is exceptionally high for Chiang Mai, much more expensive than other places in the region, which is exactly why I chose this clinic. I expected a professional, high-quality treatment.

In hindsight, I should have known better: a place without a website and without a price list is a red flag. Unfortunately, my concerns were confirmed.

Although the entrance looks fancy and impressive at first glance, the reality inside is very different. It started with being given dirty, unhygienic flip-flops. The treatment area itself was scruffy, poorly maintained, and not welcoming at all. The headband was unpleasant, and the blanket felt unclean and unhygienic. At these prices, one expects disposable products and freshly washed towels, but that was not the case.

The products used during the facial were not high quality and felt insufficient, especially considering the premium price. Overall, I felt uncomfortable and misled, and certainly not treated at a level that justifies such high costs.

My husband and I booked the same facial treatment, yet we received two completely different treatments, which further underlines the lack of professionalism and consistency.

Additionally, the existing reviews strongly give the impression that many of them may not be genuine. The young women at the reception spend hours on their phones, and it appears possible that staff are encouraged to write reviews themselves. Many reviewers have very few other reviews, and even the photos seem to be taken only from their workstations — which would explain why there are almost exclusively pictures of the entrance. This creates a misleading impression and feels dishonest.
Instead of investing time in creating a false image, the clinic would be far better off cleaning the treatment rooms, slippers and ensuring proper hygiene standards.

I do feel sorry for the staff, as they were kind and polite and likely not responsible for the overall standards or management decisions. However, friendliness alone does not compensate for an unsanitary, inconsistent, and severely overpriced treatment.

Very disappointing and misleading experience.
